qa_pairs.question: Where can Alliance users access the Metrix portal specifically for the Nibi cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: Alliance users can access the Metrix portal for the Nibi cluster at https://portal.nibi.sharcnet.ca.

qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of the Metrix portal accessible via https://portal.nibi.sharcnet.ca?
qa_pairs.answer: The Metrix portal, including the one accessible via https://portal.nibi.sharcnet.ca, is a website for Alliance users that collects information on compute nodes and management servers to interactively generate data for tracking resource usage (CPUs, GPUs, memory, filesystems) in real time.
